capabilities: Gather vault notes by overlapping Bible passage ranges
Group commentaries, notes, sermons, illustrations and books into sidebar sections
Order commentaries by a priority list written in a note
Show selected Bible translations and insert passage text into notes
Search illustrations by theme, type, audience, season or passage
disambiguation: Not a general reading or navigation guide; it organizes vault notes by Bible passage references.
extras: Korean interface and default folder names; ships no Bible text, so users must supply public-domain or legally owned translation JSON files; free for personal, church and non-profit use but not open source; may not load on iOS/iPadOS before 16.4.
motivation: To implement the principle of Logos Bible's Passage Guide—resources tied to the same passage coordinate—inside an Obsidian vault.
problem: Notes about the same Bible passage are scattered across folders and properties, with no single view that collects and orders them.

relations.evidence: 로고스 바이블의 Passage Guide 원리 — 모든 자료가 같은 본문 좌표로 묶여 있다 — 를 옵시디언 볼트 안에서 구현한 플러그인입니다.

summary: Bible-study sidebar that gathers commentaries, notes, sermons, illustrations and books touching a passage, ordered by a user-defined priority list.
